verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਰਜਿ ਆਥਵੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਰੀ ਚਮਕਨਿ ਤਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: eikat sooraj aathavai raat aneree chamakan taare|

en.bdb: Once the son sets in the evening stars twinkle in the dark night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਸਵਨਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚੋਰ ਫਿਰਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੁਸਣੈਹਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: saeh savan ghar aapanai chor firan ghar musanaihaare|

en.bdb: Rich people sleep in their homes but the thieves move around to commit thefts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਨਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਪਾਹਰੂ ਰੂਆਇਨਿ ਹੁਸੀਆਰ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jaagan virale paaharoo rooaain huseeaar bidhaare|

en.bdb: A few guards remain awake and go on shouting to alert others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਿ ਜਗਾਇਨਿ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਸਾਹ ਫੜੰਦੇ ਚੋਰ ਚਗਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jaag jagain sutiaa saeh faRa(n)dhe chor chagaare|

en.bdb: Those awakened watchmen make sleeping people awake and this way they catch hold of thiefs and vagabonds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਗਦਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਸੁਤੇ ਘਰ ਮੁਸਨਿ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jaagadhiaa ghar rakhiaa sute ghar musan vechaare|

en.bdb: Those who remain awake protect their homes but the house is looted of those who go on sleeping.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹ ਆਏ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰਿ ਲੈ ਗਰਦਨਿ ਮਾਰੈ।
verses.translit_en: saeh aae ghar aapanai chor jaar lai garadhan maarai|

en.bdb: The rich men handing over the thieves (to the authorities), happily return home but caught from their necks the thieves are beaten hollow.
The evil and the meritorious both are active in this world.
